title: Liber Loagaeth — The Book of Speech from God
subtitle: Sloane MS 3189, British Library
dictationOrder: Reverse — Leaf 49 dictated first, Leaf 1 last

manuscript.condition: Variable — some leaves clearer than others

globalStructuralNotes.gridFormat: Standard grid is 49 rows × 49 columns = 2,401 cells per side. Leaf 1 deviates (words per cell). Leaf 49 deviates (text only, no grid).
globalStructuralNotes.contentTypes: Most grids contain single Latin alphabet letters. Some cells contain Enochian characters, numbers, or marks. Some grids show checkerboard patterns (alternating filled/blank cells).
globalStructuralNotes.borderCells: Multiple scholars note that outermost rows and columns on many leaves contain different character distributions from interior cells.
globalStructuralNotes.languageAnalysis: Computerized frequency analysis of the grid text identified 167,423 three-letter chunks. Character distributions suggest linguistic rather than random arrangement. The longest recurring combination is 17 letters: 'adnachephalzednoc'.
globalStructuralNotes.crossLeafPatterns: Burns & Moore have proposed that leaves relate to each other in pairs or groups, though the specific mapping is not fully established.

transcriptionSources.name: Joseph Peterson
transcriptionSources.coverage: Multiple leaves transcribed; the most extensive publicly available transcription

transcriptionSources.name: Donald Laycock
transcriptionSources.coverage: Focused on Leaves 1-2; linguistic frequency analysis

transcriptionSources.name: Aaron Leitch
transcriptionSources.coverage: Structural analysis, selected transcriptions, context within Enochian system

transcriptionSources.name: Teresa Burns & J. Alan Moore
transcriptionSources.publication: Journal of the Western Mystery Tradition
transcriptionSources.coverage: Structural symmetry analysis of selected leaves

recto.description: The front of Leaf 1 was dictated with complete Enochian words in each cell. Because writing words in the tiny cells of a 49×49 grid was impractical, Dee recorded this table as 49 paragraphs of text rather than a filled grid.
recto.transcriptionSource: Peterson (esotericarchives.com), from Sloane MS 3189
recto.structuralNotes: Unlike all other leaves, Leaf 1 recto contains multi-character entries per cell position. The content was recorded as continuous text organized by row, not as a visual grid. This is the last leaf dictated — dictation proceeded from leaf 49 to leaf 1.

verso.description: The back of Leaf 1 has words in the first 40 rows and single letters in the last 9 rows — a transitional format between the word-grid of the recto and the single-letter grids of the remaining leaves.
verso.transcriptionSource: Peterson (esotericarchives.com), from Sloane MS 3189
verso.structuralNotes: Rows 1-40 contain Enochian words per cell. Rows 41-49 contain single letters per cell. This transitional format appears only on this leaf.

scholarshipNotes.observation: Focused linguistic analysis on Leaf 1; identified character frequency patterns suggesting linguistic rather than random structure.
Published transcription of the word-per-cell text. Notes that border cells differ from interior cells.
Reported possible rotational symmetry — rotating 180° produces partial mirror patterns.
Discusses Leaf 1 structure in The Angelical Language Vol. 1, Ch. 13. Notes the recto-verso relationship as potentially complementary.

symmetryAnalysis.description: Partial 180° rotational correspondence observed in the letter patterns.
Recto and verso may be structurally complementary or inversely constructed.

recto.description: Leaf 49 contains only text — five lines of Enochian words. It has no grid structure. This was the first leaf dictated, and its distinctive format has led scholars to consider it a 'key' or preface to the remaining 48 grid-leaves.
recto.transcriptionSource: Peterson (esotericarchives.com), from Sloane MS 3189
recto.structuralNotes: No grid. Five lines of Enochian text. First leaf dictated (dictation order 1). Some scholars interpret this as an invocation, key, or index for the grid-leaves that follow.

verso.description: Verso of Leaf 49. Content status requires verification against manuscript images.
verso.structuralNotes: Requires verification against BL digitized images of Sloane MS 3189.

scholarshipNotes.observation: Published transcription of the five text lines. Notes its distinctive non-grid format.
Discusses Leaf 49 as potentially a 'key' leaf — an invocation framework or structural key to the other 48 leaves.

_dataStatus: STRUCTURAL METADATA COMPLETE. Cell-level transcription data for individual leaves marked PENDING_TRANSCRIPTION. Grid dimensions confirmed for standard leaves (49×49). Leaf 1 (word-grid) and Leaf 49 (text-only) documented as structural exceptions.
